Surat & Mumbai: India's studded gold jewellery exports rose 31.31% to $3.69bn in April-September FY27, while plain gold fell 8.81% to $2.53bn, GJEPC data released 24 October shows.

The India-UK trade deal and lower US tariffs lifted studded gold demand from Hong Kong, Singapore and France; high gold prices held plain gold back. Full story on caratcapital.org, link in bio. Source: GJEPC via Indian Jeweller, 24 Oct 2026.

Gold in Surat: 24K Rs12,202/g, 22K Rs11,185/g; silver Rs1,64,313/kg -- 23 Oct tape, USD/INR 95.00.
